query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

**Farewell, Meme Lord Stephen! 🎉**

They say the best engineers don't just write code—they write *legacy*. Stephen, you're leaving behind both (and a Slack channel that will never recover).

From debugging the impossible to dropping memes at the exact moment morale needed a boost, you truly understood the full stack—**technical *and* emotional**. You didn't just build systems; you built *joy* into our culture, one perfectly timed GIF at a time.

The repo will miss your commits. The team will miss your wit. And #random? #random is already in mourning.

Go forth and optimize whatever comes next—they're lucky to get you. Just promise us one thing: wherever you land, keep the memes flowing. The internet needs engineers like you. *We* needed engineers like you.

**LGTM, Stephen. Ship it. 🚀**

*P.S. — Your meme folder. Hand it over. This is non-negotiable.*

---

Want me to adjust the tone (more roast, more heartfelt, shorter for a card)?
